escalations.title: Vitest RCE — Arbitrary File Execution via UI Server
escalations.detail: vitest ≤3.2.5 allows an attacker to read/execute arbitrary files when the Vitest UI server is running. Affects Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend.

escalations.title: OpenTelemetry DoS — Production Service Crash via Metrics Endpoint
escalations.detail: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node@0.40.3 in portal/Backend crashes the process on malformed HTTP to /metrics. High production availability risk.

escalations.title: UUID Buffer Overflow — Out-of-Bounds Write in ID Generation
escalations.detail: uuid@9.0.0 in Source/Backend has an out-of-bounds write in UUID v3/v5/v6 generation. If uuid is used for work item IDs, this could cause memory corruption.

p1_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md — 70 Requirements with Zero Implementation
p1_findings.detail: 70 FR-001..069 + FR-dependency-seed requirements in the primary domain spec have zero implementation references. The actual codebase only implements FR-WF-001..013 from workflow-engine.md. This generates false negatives in coverage metrics and will mislead future agents that read Specifications/ as authoritative.
p1_findings.recommendation: Determine intent: (a) archive to docs/archive/ if superseded, (b) move to Plans/ if planned future product, or (c) create an implementation pipeline if it should be built.

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Scans Plans/ Not Specifications/ — False Assurance
p2_findings.detail: The enforcer always reports PASSED by scanning Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (13 FRs). It ignores the 73 unimplemented requirements in Specifications/. Config at inspector.config.yml:36-37 also has a mismatched regex (FR-\d+ vs actual FR-WF-\d+ format).
p2_findings.recommendation: Either extend enforcer to scan Specifications/ via --specs flag, OR update inspector.config.yml to reflect actual enforcer behaviour.

p2_findings.title: Route Handlers Directly Access Data Store — Service Layer Bypassed
p2_findings.detail: All three route files import directly from workItemStore, calling store.createWorkItem(), findById(), softDelete() in request handlers. CLAUDE.md explicitly prohibits direct DB/store calls from routes.
p2_findings.recommendation: Introduce workItemService.ts wrapping the store for CRUD + validation. Routes call service, handle only HTTP concerns.

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion — 4 DoS CVEs (transitive via build tools)
p2_findings.recommendation: Run npm audit fix; update transitive via lockfile resolution

p2_findings.title: form-data — CRLF Injection (transitive)
p2_findings.recommendation: Update transitive form-data to patched version via npm audit fix

p2_findings.title: nanoid — 2 Infinite Loop CVEs (transitive)
p2_findings.recommendation: Update nanoid via vite upgrade or forced resolution

p2_findings.title: react-router-dom — Open Redirect (transitive)
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade react-router-dom 6.30.6 → 7.18.2 (breaking change — audit route definitions)

p2_findings.title: ws — Memory Exhaustion DoS (transitive)
p2_findings.recommendation: Update ws via npm audit fix --force if needed

p2_findings.title: @opentelemetry/* — 10 HIGH CVEs in portal/Backend
p2_findings.detail: OpenTelemetry SDK at 0.47.0 is 174 versions behind (current 0.221.0). Multiple HIGH severity CVEs across the telemetry stack.
p2_findings.recommendation: Batch upgrade OpenTelemetry ecosystem in portal/Backend. Coordinate with DA-002 escalation.
